summary: Iteration 7 - email+password auth. Backend: 16/16 pytest pass (login, cookie flags, case-insensitive email, same error for wrong pw/unknown/no-password user, 5-fail lockout 429 + success clears counter, CORS creds, admin-created temp password + forced change, admin reset kills sessions + password_set activity log, sub-admin 403 self/out-of-scope, forgot-password always ok + single 1h token, reset single-use/expired/unknown 400, no password_hash leakage, bcrypt $2b$, legacy session tokens via Bearer+cookie). Frontend: login page (no Google), inline errors, forgot flow, Ravi->/dashboard + reload persists, admin->/admin, all 8 admin tabs load, Team NO PASSWORD/TEMP PASSWORD tags, add employee with first password, RESET PASSWORD modal (short pw validation), forced /change-password blocks /dashboard,/leave,/admin, mismatch/wrong-current/reuse errors, header Password change, reset-password page (no token, bogus, mismatch, valid, reuse), /leave apply regression. Found and FIXED 1 critical frontend bug (reset link bounced logged-out users to /). Found 1 HIGH security bug (sub-admin can set an ADMIN's password) and 1 HIGH config gap (owner admin has no password, ADMIN_PASSWORD not set).

critical.issue: Privilege escalation: a sub_admin can set the password of an ADMIN (or another sub_admin) who is in their scope (same department/site/manager). Reproduced: admin created in 'Field Operations' -> test_session_subadmin_001 PATCHed password -> 200 -> logged in as that admin (role=admin). ensure_manages_other only blocks self + out-of-scope. Fix: if actor is sub_admin, reject targets whose role is admin or sub_admin (403). Same check probably needed for edit/delete/reset-face.

ADMIN_PASSWORD is not in backend/.env (only ADMIN_EMAIL), so seeding is skipped. Real owner shashank@gtgroups.in has NO password (Team tab shows NO PASSWORD) and Google sign-in is removed; forgot-password email is blocked by insufficient_credits -> the owner currently cannot sign in by any UI path. Set ADMIN_PASSWORD (or have an admin set it) and confirm.

minor.issue: must_change_password is enforced only in the frontend router. A temp-password session can call any API (e.g. /api/attendance/today, /api/announcements returned 200). Consider rejecting non-auth endpoints with 403 while must_change_password is true.
Per-IP lockout uses the first X-Forwarded-For value, which the client controls: 8 failures with spoofed XFF never hit 429 (only the per-email 10 limit stops it). Use the last/trusted proxy hop.

Password is .strip()ped before hashing on set/reset/change, but login verifies the raw input. A password set as '  Spaced@123  ' cannot be used exactly as typed (401), only stripped (200). Either don't strip or strip consistently in login.
Voluntary password change does not revoke the user's other sessions (other session still 200 afterwards). Admin reset and email reset do revoke.
Only deletes the cookie session; a Bearer-only logout leaves the session valid (frontend clears localStorage, so low impact).
Email send is awaited inline, so response time differs for real vs unknown emails (timing-based enumeration). Consider background task.

ui_bugs.issue: FIXED BY TESTER: AuthProvider calls /auth/me on load; for a logged-out user it 401s and the global handler did window.location.replace('/') for any path != '/'. Result: opening the emailed /reset-password?token=... link while signed out bounced straight to the login page, so the whole forgot-password flow was unusable. Added 'me' to the isAuthAttempt regex. Verified reset page now stays and the full valid-token flow works.

rca of the issue: Reset link bounce: AuthProvider.checkAuth -> GET /auth/me -> 401 (no session) -> api.js response interceptor (URL not in isAuthAttempt) -> onUnauthorized -> window.location.replace('/') because pathname was /reset-password. Earlier manual test passed only because the tester was already logged in. Mitigation applied: treat /auth/me as an auth endpoint in the interceptor (checkAuth already handles the null user).
